top_issues.issue: Error toast obscures the failed message and its recovery action.
top_issues.evidence: Toast occupies approximately x393–887, y644–692; failed-message status and Retry sit immediately beneath it around y690.
top_issues.fix: Place the toast above the failed-message row with a 16-point gap, or reserve a 48-point notification region above the composer; keep the entire Retry button visible.

top_issues.issue: Fixed navigation consumes too much of a narrow window and truncates identities.
top_issues.evidence: At 760×640, the rail plus list ends at x296, consuming 39% of width. Chat names such as Katherine Johnson and several Calls names are ellipsized.
top_issues.fix: Below 900 points, provide a collapsible 200-point list or a list/detail transition with a 32-point Back control; preserve at least 440 points for conversation content.

top_issues.issue: Live call status conflicts with the visible ended-meeting state.
top_issues.evidence: Top band y14–44 says In the meeting / just joined, while the final event says Meeting ended at y476 in call-bar and y416 in call-docked.
top_issues.fix: If these refer to separate sessions, label the separator Previous meeting in 12-point semibold and date the ended event; otherwise replace the top status with Meeting ended and a Rejoin action.

top_issues.issue: The first-run hierarchy foregrounds technical configuration over the step that makes it possible.
top_issues.evidence: Card x405–875, y262–642 contains GUID and tenant fields; How to register Wren appears at y555 beside disabled Save, after both fields.
top_issues.fix: Move a primary Set up app registration action above the fields, use a 3-step list in 14-point text, and put environment-variable instructions behind an Advanced disclosure.

top_issues.issue: Calls screen reads like a capability document instead of an action surface.
top_issues.evidence: At 1280×800, explanatory sections occupy roughly y238–748; at 760×640, they continue below the viewport after Call status.
top_issues.fix: Keep Join and recent people first; reduce explanation to two 14-point lines and put the capability list under a How calls work disclosure with 16-point section spacing.

top_issues.issue: Long draft text touches the top clipping edge and reads as an unstructured block.
top_issues.evidence: Composer starts at y550; first visible line is cut at y557, and successive lines are approximately 17 pixels apart.
top_issues.fix: Use 12-point internal padding, 14-point draft text with 20-point line spacing, and reveal the caret line with at least 8 points above and below it.

top_issues.issue: Technical explanation interrupts behavioural settings and uses a repository-path reference in product copy.
top_issues.evidence: Paragraph at x382–865, y432–471 discusses polling, a push relay and docs/realtime.md between checkbox rows.
top_issues.fix: Replace with a two-line 13-point explanation of when messages refresh; put connection setup behind a labelled Configure instant alerts action with a 16-point gap.

top_issues.issue: Persistent formatting help and some metadata are too small for comfortable reading, despite passing sampled colour contrast.
top_issues.evidence: Composer-help glyphs occupy about y777–785 at 1280×800; in 380-pixel call-bar the same help wraps across y763–784. Measured helper foreground #62656d on #ffffff is 5.83:1; dark #9c9ea8 on #17181b is 6.65:1.
top_issues.fix: Use 12-point help text; show only Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line by default and move formatting syntax into a help popover. Use 12-point attachment and mention metadata.

top_issues.issue: Cropped thumbnails make it difficult to identify the exact image being sent.
top_issues.evidence: Three previews occupy x393–841, y622–718; first image shows partial birds and the third contains only clipped fragments of the image.
top_issues.fix: Fit each full image within a 144×96-point tile with letterboxing; add a 12-point filename or dimensions label and keep remove controls at least 24×24 points.

top_issues.issue: Reading and writing regions use mismatched widths.
top_issues.evidence: Message cards and date rules stop near x1300, leaving over 600 pixels to the right, while composer spans x380–1904.
top_issues.fix: Cap the composer at the same 920-point width as the message column, align their left edges, and anchor message actions to that shared column.

top_issues.issue: Neutral selection fills are subtle and similar to hover fills.
top_issues.evidence: Chat selected fill #e4e4e8 against sidebar #f6f6f7 is approximately 1.17:1; dark selected fill #34353c against #1d1e22 is approximately 1.36:1. Orange active icons in rail and channel views help, but the selected chat lacks an equivalent marker.
top_issues.fix: Add a persistent 3-point leading selection marker in #a9530f light / #e88c3e dark; retain the neutral fill for breadth. Do not rely on fill contrast alone.

top_issues.issue: Secondary button outlines provide very little visual separation from their surfaces.
top_issues.evidence: Sampled Clear boundary #dfdfe3 on #ffffff is 1.33:1; dark #303137 on #25262b is 1.16:1. Same values sampled on Copy the link and Leave demo. Labels themselves remain legible, so this is not a demonstrated text-contrast failure.
top_issues.fix: Where an outline communicates the hit area, use #8a8d95 light and #6e7179 dark, measured at 3.32:1 and 3.09:1 against the respective surfaces; keep 32-point minimum button height.

top_issues.issue: Save versus Clear is unclear with an empty-looking status field.
top_issues.evidence: Placeholder is visible in the field at y208–258, while both filled Save and outlined Clear remain available at y277–308.
top_issues.fix: Disable Save until the draft differs from the current status; disable Clear when no status exists, or label the destructive action Remove status. Maintain a 32-point action height and 8-point spacing.

top_issues.issue: Zoom toolbar does not explicitly distinguish the active fit mode from actual image scale.
top_issues.evidence: Fit is tinted at x176–211; 100% appears beside it, while the displayed 3072-pixel-wide image fits a roughly 928-pixel-wide viewport. The screenshot cannot establish whether 100% is a command or a readout.
top_issues.fix: Label the command Actual size (100%), show an explicit Zoom: 30% readout for this fit, and indicate Fit selection with the same selected-control treatment used in Settings.
